title: Lovely stay in a great spot
text: The room was spotless and the staff made check-in so easy. Close to the station and everything we wanted to see.

title: Could not sleep
text: The location is excellent and the receptionist was kind, but noise from the street went on late and the window did not block it.

title: Good value for a short stay
text: Friendly team and a comfortable bed. The bathroom could use a refresh, but the room was clean and the location was handy.

title: Disappointing room
text: Check-in took almost an hour and the air conditioning was not working. The staff apologised but could not move us.

title: Convenient and welcoming
text: Great location near the train. Reception was helpful when we arrived early. A little dated, but good value.

title: A little gem
text: Really lovely team, crisp sheets and a quiet room at the back. Plenty of cafes within a few minutes walk.

title: Fine for one night
text: Room was clean enough and the staff were pleasant. The shower pressure was low and the hallway was noisy.

title: Would stay again
text: Fantastic location for the harbour. Spotless room, comfortable bed and a very smooth check-in.

title: Needs attention
text: There was dust on the shelves and a musty smell in the room. Reception was polite but the issue was not fixed.

title: Great neighbourhood
text: The room was compact but comfortable and the location is wonderful. Helpful receptionist gave us local tips.

title: Great little hotel
text: Everything was easy, the facilities were good and the room was fresh. Lots of restaurants nearby.

title: Mixed experience
text: Excellent location but noisy plumbing through the night. Staff offered earplugs and were kind.

title: Comfortable and convenient
text: Clean room, friendly staff, easy walk to the station. The building is older but well maintained.

title: Not as described
text: The facilities felt tired and the room needed a proper clean. Check-in was friendly and the area is nice.

title: Good base for exploring
text: Very convenient location and staff were welcoming. Some traffic noise, but overall a comfortable stay.

title: Excellent location
text: Beautiful views nearby, comfortable room and helpful front desk. Great value for the area.

title: A bit noisy
text: The room was tidy and the location worked well. Thin walls meant we could hear people in the corridor.

title: Perfect weekend
text: Warm welcome, lovely clean room and brilliant cafes close by. We will be back.

title: Room needs a refresh
text: The bed was uncomfortable and the air conditioning rattled all night. Staff tried to help.

title: Would recommend
text: Easy check-in, clean bathroom and a short walk to the harbour. Friendly reception.

title: Lovely staff
text: Receptionist was so helpful with our bags. Quiet, clean room and great transport links.

title: Good location, average room
text: Close to everything and the staff were nice. The room was small and the bathroom fixtures were old.

title: Pleasant stay
text: Clean comfortable room and a smooth check-in. Good value and plenty of food options nearby.

title: Not very clean
text: Found hair in the bathroom and the air conditioner did not cool the room. Location was the only positive.
